# Mohamed Adel — Flutter Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Mohamed Adel, a Flutter developer building cross-platform
> mobile apps for iOS and Android.

This site is statically pre-rendered (Jaspr, a Dart static-site framework) —
project, experience, and expertise content is baked into plain HTML at build
time, so a plain HTTP fetch of any URL below returns the real visible content
directly, no JavaScript execution required.

## Sections

- [Home](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/): Hero introduction, About, Expertise, Experience, Projects, and Contact, all on one scrollable page.
- [About](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/about): Background and technical expertise.
- [Projects](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/projects): Case studies of shipped mobile apps.
- [Contact](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/contact): Contact form and direct contact links.
